links.targetTitle: DocumentToolbar exposes className enabledControls and callback props
Toolbar buttons must be styled via Tailwind arbitrary child selectors since they have no dedicated style props

title: customControls adds controls to a DocumentToolbar slot, rendering at the slot start unless position is end
description: Each slot takes one CustomToolbarControl or a keyed list. position defaults to "start". Passing children switches to a mutually exclusive mode where customControls is ignored.
